scope: JavaScript/TypeScript npm SDKs, official AI SDK providers and verified direct community SDKs. SDKs support at least one documented API family. Model-level provider mapping, endpoint compatibility and native SDK/API-family mapping are audited separately. Retired models are historical interface references, not currently callable models. SDK package versions in this audit are research snapshots, not required pins. No paid inference requests were made.

rules.protocol_basis: Model API family comes from the model official sources; SDK documentation confirms support for that vendor API family. The SDK takes a model identifier or native request body. This does not populate missing endpoints or establish present availability.
